focus: Reconstruct native replay state, then connect it to live playback.
note: The game is playable, but the offline rewrite is not yet equivalent to Worms Armageddon. Verified routines can still be waiting for live integration.

areas.title: Worm movement & physics
areas.live: Native collision masks, jump flight, hurt motion, drowning and several recovery paths are integrated.
areas.remaining: Complete the movement/state lifecycle, ground interactions and collision ordering; compare full movement sequences with the original.

areas.title: Weapons & inventory
areas.live: Original weapon data and many projectile, melee, hitscan and placed-weapon routines drive live play.
areas.remaining: Finish every weapon state machine, scheme override, special-availability rule, ammo-loading path and utility delay lifecycle.

areas.title: Damage & destruction
areas.live: Native blast, crater, damage accounting, flames and crate/barrel behavior are substantially integrated.
areas.remaining: Complete event ordering and remaining collision/chain-reaction paths, then validate composed sequences against native matches.

areas.title: Rope & utilities
areas.live: Recovered rope launch, swing, release and refire behavior is integrated alongside original utility art and several utility actions.
areas.remaining: Finish native control and state transitions for jetpack, parachute, teleport, girders, freeze and other utilities; verify their interactions.

areas.title: Turns & match rules
areas.live: Native team/worm rotation, wind selection, settlement presentation, poison settlement and recurring environment effects are integrated.
areas.remaining: Connect the complete native turn controller, action-busy ownership, retreat requests, input gates and scheme rules.

areas.title: Maps & terrain
areas.live: Original authored maps, terrain objects, collision masks and animated water are available in the game.
areas.remaining: Complete native procedural generation, placement constraints, bridges, terrain-theme behavior and terrain history/dirty-region handling.

areas.title: Sprites, animation & HUD
areas.live: Original media, native animation routines and many HUD elements are integrated, including the animated wind meter.
areas.remaining: Finish the complete animation state graph, remaining poses and HUD transitions, renderer/task visibility and native scheduling.

areas.title: Sound & speech
areas.live: Original samples, speech banks and several native sound queues, loops and event triggers are integrated.
areas.remaining: Complete sound ownership, priorities, speech selection and remaining event triggers across all actor states.

areas.title: Computer opponents
areas.live: A playable computer opponent is present. Its host heuristics are not a complete port of the original AI.
areas.remaining: Port native movement planning, trajectory search, weapon selection and difficulty behavior.

areas.title: Setup, missions & progression
areas.live: Local match setup, authored-map selection, schemes and series play are available.
areas.remaining: Reproduce native team setup, saved schemes, missions, training and campaign progression.

areas.title: Replays & local saves
areas.live: The current replay is a trajectory overlay. Native replay controls, buffers, serialization, environment reconstruction and all 21 child constructors have executable comparisons; these await full snapshot and live integration.
areas.remaining: Finish root/controller and recursive snapshot reconstruction, rendering resource adapters, game-state mapping and event playback; replace the overlay with deterministic replay and local saves.

areas.title: Determinism & whole-match parity
areas.live: A 50 Hz simulation and native random streams underpin many executable-verified routines.
areas.remaining: Finish original input queues, dispatch order and random-call ordering; compare representative complete matches with the original executable.
